title: The dumpster by day
logline: The dumpster behind the Lanes in April daylight, the pup's nose to its corner as always, and the corner itself, close: twenty-three years of noses have worn the paint. The page draws the worn patch.

panels.composition: Close on the lower corner of a dumpster in daylight with the paint worn to bare metal in one patch at a dog's nose height, a small three-legged dog's nose at it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on the lower corner of a dumpster in daylight with the paint worn to bare metal in a patch at nose height and a small three-legged dog's nose pressed to it, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
